snippet.title: 14: Overmind  |  Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
14:OVERMIND Demo is OUT NOW!

Available on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3610160/14_Overmind_Demo/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=trailer

A space survival game where you will challenge the vastness of space. Explore new worlds, build your own spaceship and transform an abandoned base into a reliable shelter. Adventures await you in a world full of mysteries, anomalies and threats.

Visit our website to learn more about our studio: https://next-genium.com/en/
